title: Backlog planning, ranking and activation
summary: Planned work has ordering independent of active board columns. Browser bulk activation processes at most 100 selected issues through individual organization commands; it is not one atomic bulk transaction.

cases.title: Read planned work
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open the project's Backlog page.
expected: Ranked planned issues and a total count appear.

cases.title: Read backlog issue metadata
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Inspect a planned row.
expected: Key, title, category, assignee, due state, blockers and labels describe the issue.

cases.title: Open a planned issue
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Follow a backlog issue link.
expected: The dedicated issue route opens.

cases.title: Load more planned work
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Choose More planned work.
expected: The next cursor page appends without duplicate rows.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0037.

cases.title: Read an empty backlog
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open a project with no planned work.
expected: The empty state explains creating planned work or sending unstarted work to backlog.

cases.title: Create planned work
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Create an issue using the backlog form.
expected: The issue is created in backlog without briefly appearing as active board work.

cases.title: Create planned work with attachments
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Create a backlog issue with queued files or pictures.
expected: Uploads finish against the one created issue before the form completes.
notes: Binary transfer details are owned by the attachments catalog.
Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0006, UC-AST-0060.

cases.title: Cancel backlog creation
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Close creation and resolve its draft confirmation.
expected: The form closes without creating another issue; focus returns to the create trigger.

cases.title: Drag a planned issue earlier
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Drag a loaded row earlier in backlog.
expected: The new backlog order survives refresh without changing active board ordering.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0038.

cases.title: Rank a planned issue earlier with keyboard controls
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Use the Rank earlier button.
expected: The new backlog order is saved without requiring a drag gesture.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0038.

cases.title: Drag a planned issue later
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Drag a loaded row later in backlog.
expected: The new backlog order survives refresh without changing active board ordering.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0039.

cases.title: Rank a planned issue later with keyboard controls
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Use the Rank later button.
expected: The new backlog order is saved without requiring a drag gesture.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0039.

cases.title: Select one planned issue
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Select its checkbox.
expected: The selected issue contributes to the activation count.

cases.title: Deselect one planned issue
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Clear its selected checkbox.
expected: The issue no longer contributes to the activation count.

cases.title: Select loaded planned issues
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Choose Select loaded.
expected: Up to 100 currently loaded rows are selected.

cases.title: Clear backlog selection
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Turn off Select loaded.
expected: Selection is cleared.

cases.title: Activate one planned issue
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Choose Move to board for one backlog row.
expected: The issue becomes active and disappears from backlog.

cases.title: Activate selected planned work
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Choose Move selected to board.
expected: Each confirmed issue leaves backlog and the success count advances.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0017.

cases.title: Preserve successful partial activation
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Retry after a later selected issue fails to activate.
expected: Previously confirmed issues remain removed while unconfirmed work is available to retry.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0017, UC-BLG-0031.

cases.title: Apply stage assignment on activation
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Activate planned work whose current stage has an enabled assignment rule.
expected: The stage-entry assignment hook runs in the activation transaction.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Keep backlog read-only for viewers
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open backlog using viewer access.
expected: Creation, selection, ranking and activation controls are unavailable.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0040.

cases.title: Reject ranking by a viewer
preconditions: Actor has only viewer access.
steps: Submit a reorder command without project write authority.
expected: The server refuses the write.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Reject more than 100 selected issues
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Select issue 101 for one activation batch.
expected: The extra selection is refused with a visible limit message.

cases.title: Reject self-anchored backlog reorder
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Use the moving issue as its own neighbor.
expected: Validation requires another planned issue.

cases.title: Reject ranking active board work
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Rank an issue currently outside backlog.
expected: Only current backlog work can be ranked.

cases.title: Reject ranking an archived backlog issue
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Rank archived planned work.
expected: Archived work cannot be ranked.

cases.title: Reject an active-board reorder anchor
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Choose a neighbor outside backlog.
expected: The anchor must be a current backlog issue.

cases.title: Reject a foreign-project reorder anchor
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Choose a neighbor in another project.
expected: The anchor is unavailable in this scoped operation.

cases.title: Reject a stale backlog order
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Reorder using an earlier backlog-order revision.
expected: Conflict requires reloading current planning order.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Reject a cursor after backlog ordering changes
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Continue pagination using a cursor from an older backlog order.
expected: The signed cursor scope refuses stale ordering.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Retry uncertain backlog creation
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Retry after an accepted create response is lost.
expected: The frozen original create/reference resolves to one backlog issue.

cases.title: Retain one created issue during upload retry
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Retry after issue creation succeeds but a queued upload fails.
expected: The existing issue ID is reused instead of issuing another create.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0031, UC-AST-0063.

cases.title: Ignore another project's delayed creation
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Navigate to another project before the old create returns.
expected: The old result cannot mark or upload the destination project's draft.

cases.title: Replace backlog context on project navigation
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Navigate to another project's backlog while a read is pending.
expected: Old lists, selection and pending commands reset; stale replies are ignored.

cases.title: Bound backlog rank maintenance
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Reorder a dense ranking whose required rebalance exceeds the service bound.
expected: A safe failure refuses unbounded rebalance work.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Retain Arabic planned titles
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Create and read planned work with Arabic text.
expected: The exact title remains readable with automatic direction.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-BLG-0041.

cases.title: Read another backlog cursor page
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Request a bounded backlog page and its signed continuation.
expected: The next distinct issue summaries retain ranked order, total and current order revision.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-BLG-0004.

cases.title: Persist backlog rank before a neighbor
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Submit a revision-aware backlog reorder before another current planned issue.
expected: A fresh backlog read retains the requested order without changing issue content or active-board rank.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-BLG-0009.

cases.title: Persist backlog rank after a neighbor
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Submit a revision-aware backlog reorder after another current planned issue.
expected: A fresh backlog read retains the requested order without changing issue content or active-board rank.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-BLG-0011.

cases.title: Enforce viewer backlog service access
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Read planned work as a viewer and attempt planned issue creation or activation.
expected: The authorized read succeeds while current write permission rejects creation and activation.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-BLG-0021.

cases.title: Retain Arabic planned text through service
preconditions: Signed in with write access to an active project.
steps: Create planned work with an Arabic title and read the stored ranked issue.
expected: The exact Unicode title and backlog identity persist.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-BLG-0036.
